# Copilot repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in this repository. Its rules apply to all agents and
all markdown work.

## Markdown documentation and content (summary)

All markdown files follow Adam's punctuation-anchored line-break style. It is a hard
format requirement: never reflow line breaks when editing,
and always use the style when writing new content.

- End each line right after a piece of punctuation:
  `.`, `;`, `:`, `,`, `—`, `!`, `?`.
- Break after commas even mid-clause; one thought per line.
- Wrap only at punctuation; never wrap by character count.
- Blank lines still separate paragraphs, headings, lists, and code blocks.
- List items follow the same rule,
  with continuation lines indented under the item text.
- Never merge lines or re-break lines that already break at punctuation.
- Rewrites that produce prose not in this style
  must be reformatted into it before finishing.

See [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for examples of correct and incorrect formatting.
